purpose: Test the released fused grouped attention path for Qwen2, separately from the inconclusive F16C kernel change.
selection: Highest decode ratio among configurations preserving all 27 raw answers, token counts, prompts and evaluations and passing model contribution gates. Freeze winner before confirmations; no alternative selected from confirmation results.
success: The selected screen and two fresh confirmations all meet unchanged qualification gates and preserve raw answers and counts. Target decode margin >=0.85.
hypothesis: Reading shared K/V once per Qwen group reduces attention overhead enough to meet performance gates without changing raw answers.
controls: Released Models0.5.9/Vectors0.1.32 only, no native override. Native16/decode8 and declared workload/reference16 remain fixed. Only fusedGroupedAttention changes. Untuned released default correctness smoke remains mandatory before every pair.
limitations: One catalog RAG corpus tests this admission gate; it is not a broad quality benchmark. RAG report records output text and token counts, not token IDs. One host cannot establish cross-host performance.

fleet.stopCondition: Exit on completion or error, terminate-on-shutdown, 150 minute hard shutdown
